## Summary
The dynacast package manages publisher-side subscription demand for audio codecs and video qualities. It aggregates local subscriber and downstream node interest, handles codec regression, debounces video downgrades, and notifies publishers when they should enable, disable, or reduce media layers.

## Responsibilities
- Define dynacast manager, manager listener, quality listener, and per-codec quality tracker contracts.
- Track audio codec enablement and video max subscribed quality per MIME type.
- Aggregate subscriber and downstream node subscription demand into committed publisher notifications.
- Handle codec regression by redirecting state from one codec quality tracker to another.
- Queue listener notifications through a serialized operation queue.
- Provide no-op manager, listener, and quality implementations for defaults and embedded unsupported operations.
